claim: The configuration single_cam_red_noDMD_nocom10.cfg declares the confocal combiner's blanking lines as the Micro-Manager device LUNF-Blanking and defines a LaserLine group whose presets 405, 488, 561 and 640 each set one blanking line to 1 -- line2, line4, line6 and line8 respectively -- and whose AllOff preset sets all four to 0. So a session that loads it can switch a confocal laser line with an ordinary Micro-Manager group call.
validity_conditions: A fact about one file: agentic-microscope at fbedef0, config/micromanager/single_cam_red_noDMD_nocom10.cfg, sha256 8184073e31e1a7a63731932a20a622131d4dba04cf839bc9e651bf9abcd53120, lines 90, 103-105, 124 and 218-238, read by this seat. That hash is the one run-20260924-002 recorded for the configuration it loaded (event 8), and that run lists LUNF-Blanking among the loaded devices. E3: a configuration written in another project. The group's line map agrees with lunf_line_map_and_blanking_polarity (405 on line2, 488 on line4, 561 on line6, 640 on line8, 1 opens), which makes two prior records agreeing and still nothing confirmed on this bench.
